title: Mystic Portal Guardian
description: A woman in a sleek black futuristic bodysuit with glowing white lines stands centered in a high-tech chamber, arms outstretched with palms up. She is surrounded by floating demonic skulls with red glowing eyes and small blue ghostly creatures, with a large luminous circular portal behind her.
prompt: A woman with long dark hair wearing a form-fitting black bodysuit with glowing cyan circuit lines stands in the center of a futuristic chamber, arms extended to her sides with palms facing up. Multiple large floating demonic skulls with glowing red eyes and horns surround her, along with small translucent blue ghost-like creatures. A large circular glowing blue energy portal is visible in the background. The floor has stacks of smooth blue stones, cool sci-fi lighting, cinematic composition.
